description: Control the N-terminal targeting test: check sensitivity to the window length and score Fmp40, which is experimentally mitochondrial, plus human SELENOO and the other comparators under the identical features
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

U="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb"
def stream_fasta(q):
    r=requests.get(f"{U}/stream",params={"query":q,"format":"fasta"},timeout=600); r.raise_for_status()
    seqs={}; acc=None; buf=[]
    for ln in r.text.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(">"):
            if acc: seqs[acc]="".join(buf)
            acc=ln.split("|")[1] if "|" in ln else ln[1:].split()[0]; buf=[]
        elif ln.strip(): buf.append(ln.strip())
    if acc: seqs[acc]="".join(buf)
    return seqs
fetch=lambda a:"".join(requests.get(f"{U}/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

pos=stream_fasta("reviewed:true AND organism_id:284812 AND ft_transit:*")
neg=stream_fasta("reviewed:true AND organism_id:284812 AND cc_scl_term:SL-0091 NOT ft_transit:*")
# S. cerevisiae reference sets, so Fmp40 can be scored against its own organism's background
posY=stream_fasta("reviewed:true AND organism_id:559292 AND ft_transit:*")
negY=stream_fasta("reviewed:true AND organism_id:559292 AND cc_scl_term:SL-0091 NOT ft_transit:*")
print("Sp transit/cyto:",len(pos),len(neg)," Sc transit/cyto:",len(posY),len(negY))

def nchg(seg): return sum(seg.count(c) for c in "KR")-sum(seg.count(c) for c in "DE")
def nR(seg): return seg.count("R")
def nAc(seg): return sum(seg.count(c) for c in "DE")

targets={"sel0 (O13890, S. pombe)":fetch("O13890"),
         "Fmp40 (Q08968, S. cerevisiae)":fetch("Q08968"),
         "SELENOO (Q9BVL4, human)":fetch("Q9BVL4"),
         "PsSelO (Q87VB1)":fetch("Q87VB1"),
         "YdiU (P77649, E. coli)":fetch("P77649")}

rows=[]
for N in [20,25,30,40,50,60]:
    for org,(P,Ng) in {"S. pombe":(pos,neg),"S. cerevisiae":(posY,negY)}.items():
        xp=np.array([nchg(s[:N]) for s in P.values() if len(s)>=N])
        xn=np.array([nchg(s[:N]) for s in Ng.values() if len(s)>=N])
        y=np.r_[np.ones(len(xp)),np.zeros(len(xn))]; x=np.r_[xp,xn]
        auc=roc_auc_score(y,x)
        rp=np.array([nR(s[:N]) for s in P.values() if len(s)>=N]); rn=np.array([nR(s[:N]) for s in Ng.values() if len(s)>=N])
        aucR=roc_auc_score(np.r_[np.ones(len(rp)),np.zeros(len(rn))],np.r_[rp,rn])
        for tn,ts in targets.items():
            v=nchg(ts[:N])
            rows.append(dict(window=N, background=org, feature="net_charge", auc=round(auc,3),
                             mean_transit=round(xp.mean(),2), mean_cyto=round(xn.mean(),2),
                             target=tn, value=v,
                             pct_of_transit_below=round(100*(xp<v).mean(),1),
                             pct_of_cyto_below=round(100*(xn<v).mean(),1),
                             auc_nArg=round(aucR,3), nArg=nR(ts[:N]), mean_nArg_transit=round(rp.mean(),2)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
T.to_csv("table14_mts_window_sensitivity.csv",index=False)

piv=T[(T.background=="S. pombe")].pivot_table(index="target",columns="window",values="value")
print("\nNet charge of the first N residues, by window (S. pombe background rows):")
print(piv.to_string())
print("\nPercentile within the transit-peptide reference set (own organism where available):")
own={"sel0 (O13890, S. pombe)":"S. pombe","Fmp40 (Q08968, S. cerevisiae)":"S. cerevisiae",
     "SELENOO (Q9BVL4, human)":"S. pombe","PsSelO (Q87VB1)":"S. pombe","YdiU (P77649, E. coli)":"S. pombe"}
sub=T[[o==own[t] for o,t in zip(T.background,T.target)]]
print(sub.pivot_table(index="target",columns="window",values="pct_of_transit_below").to_string())
print("\nAUC of net charge, transit vs cytosolic, by window:")
print(T.pivot_table(index="background",columns="window",values="auc").to_string())
print("\nArg count in first N residues:")
print(T[T.background=="S. pombe"].pivot_table(index="target",columns="window",values="nArg").to_string())

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
for tn in targets:
    d=T[(T.target==tn)&(T.background=="S. pombe")]
    ax.plot(d.window,d.value,marker="o",lw=2 if "sel0" in tn or "Fmp40" in tn else 1.2,
            ls="-" if ("sel0" in tn or "Fmp40" in tn) else "--",label=tn.split(" (")[0])
d0=T[(T.background=="S. pombe")&(T.target=="sel0 (O13890, S. pombe)")]
ax.plot(d0.window,d0.mean_transit,color="#c2724a",lw=2.5,alpha=0.6,label="mean, S. pombe transit peptides")
ax.plot(d0.window,d0.mean_cyto,color="#7aa6c2",lw=2.5,alpha=0.6,label="mean, S. pombe cytosolic")
ax.set_xlabel("N-terminal window length (residues)"); ax.set_ylabel("net charge (K+R) - (D+E)")
ax.set_title("Presequence-like positive charge is absent from sel0 and from Fmp40")
ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.6); ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]
P,Ng=pos,neg; N=40
xp=np.array([nchg(s[:N]) for s in P.values() if len(s)>=N]); xn=np.array([nchg(s[:N]) for s in Ng.values() if len(s)>=N])
bins=np.arange(min(xn.min(),xp.min())-0.5,max(xp.max(),xn.max())+1.5,1)
ax.hist(xn,bins=bins,alpha=0.55,density=True,color="#7aa6c2",label=f"cytosolic (n={len(xn)})")
ax.hist(xp,bins=bins,alpha=0.55,density=True,color="#c2724a",label=f"transit peptide (n={len(xp)})")
for tn,col in [("sel0 (O13890, S. pombe)","k"),("Fmp40 (Q08968, S. cerevisiae)","#2d6a4f")]:
    v=nchg(targets[tn][:N]); ax.axvline(v,color=col,lw=2.2,ls="--")
    ax.annotate(tn.split(" (")[0],(v,ax.get_ylim()[1]*(0.92 if col=="k" else 0.80)),xytext=(5,0),
                textcoords="offset points",fontweight="bold",color=col,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge of first 40 residues"); ax.set_ylabel("density")
ax.set_title(f"S. pombe reference sets, AUC = {roc_auc_score(np.r_[np.ones(len(xp)),np.zeros(len(xn))],np.r_[xp,xn]):.3f}")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
